about: Controlled vocabulary for the RemoteCompose example catalog (docs/EXAMPLES_TAXONOMY.md). Capabilities carry synonyms (what users type) and evidence (JSON keys or calls that must appear in a document claiming them). Search normalises a query (lower case, singular, hyphens and spaces equivalent), expands synonyms to ids, then scores examples. Components (library templates, see the 'Component templates' section) have their own synonyms; a query term may resolve to a component, a capability and a use case at once.
